paths.name: The Gathering Storm
paths.description: Lightning that reaches further, forks wider and lands harder.

paths.name: The Turning Tide
paths.description: The blade that never stops turning: spin through them, drag them under, and drink from the fight.

paths.name: The Long Shadow
paths.description: Step through the dark and shoot out of it: the Veil, the Umbra and the long shot.

paths.name: The Banked Fire
paths.description: Hold your ground and keep them in the fire: heavy blows that burn, a fire banked around you, and the life to stand in it.

paths.name: The Echo
paths.description: What happened once happens again: echoes, held moments and long storms.

specialties.name: The Hearth
specialties.description: Stand in the fire and outlast it: life, armour, and a hearth that flares back at every blow.

specialties.name: The Kiln
specialties.description: Everything you strike keeps burning: fire that lands harder and leaves the ground alight under them.

specialties.name: The Rockfall
specialties.description: Heavy blows that bring the hillside down: slower swings that land harder and throw them far.

specialties.name: The Maelstrom
specialties.description: The spin that drags the room into it: the Millwheel pulls them in, widens and holds them close.

specialties.name: The Spring Tide
specialties.description: Drink from the fight: every blow gives back, and the flasks never run dry.

specialties.name: The Tidal Bore
specialties.description: Ride the wave in: every roll throws water ahead of you, and the Millrace runs far and fast.

specialties.name: The Squall Line
specialties.description: A storm that walks with you: storms that stay close, follow you and heal you.

specialties.name: The Forked Sky
specialties.description: Lightning that never stops at one: more jumps, more bolts, and every kill forks again.

specialties.name: The Static Front
specialties.description: The charge in the air before it breaks: deep mana, heavy brands, and lightning that answers when you are struck.

specialties.name: The Hailfall
specialties.description: Volleys that break across a crowd: more bolts, wider fans, and shots that leap on.

specialties.name: The Penumbra
specialties.description: Carry the dark with you: an Umbra that grows, lasts, and rises again on every kill.

specialties.name: The Far Dark
specialties.description: The long shot from deep cover: bolts that drive through everything, and a veil after every roll.

weaponGroups.name: Blade
weaponGroups.holds: swords, sabres, knives, dirks and axes
